title: Croatian Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew originating from Croatia, made with tender beef, vegetables, and a rich broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onions to the pot and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and Dijon mustard.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
